market_story: Zero-forcing twin is near-identical (CT_PEAKER +0.6/+0.27/+0.47 TWh 2023/24/25, all other classes < 0.3 TWh): the only binding merchant floor is the CT evening reliability deployment -- real MISO commits peakers for evening net-load-peak reliability (RA/LOLE-driven commitment the LP's energy-only merit cannot see), D-2 attributes 3.7-8.1% of CT energy to it (cap 15%). The CT offer level itself is measured (CAMPD part-load 1.025 + Order-825/ELMP fast-start start-cost amortization over CAMPD-measured run lengths), so the class's energy is carried economically, not forced.
